race.description: Archers The Strata Professionals Mdn Plate
race.comment: KOWLOON MAGNATE (8) found the line nicely to grab third last time out over the mile at Taree. Has been knocking on the door throughout this prep and gets a good chance to finally get the job done. BRASS BAND (5) is desperate to break through soon after a string of minor placings. Doesn't have to improve much to finally break through this time. MISSILE AWAY (10) was better here last time when in the market, only beaten 2.2L back in sixth. Drops back in trip off 26 days and has peaks that measure up. BOBBY'S MY MATE (4) got too far back last start at the Gold Coast but made good late inroads. Peaking now and can play a role in the finish.
